code.note: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。

art.note: 披露的 Art 一条说部分食物与烹饪相关道具最初用 AI 辅助工具生成、再由自家美术按游戏视觉风格与质量标准手工精修，即美术领域存在 AI 参与但开发者强调后续人工修正。
art.quote: Some food and cooking-related props were initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by our artists to match the game's visual style and quality standards.

music.note: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。披露的 Audio 一条讲的是顾客短促语音，没有涉及音乐，本站不把 audio 一词自动映射成音乐领域。

voice.note: 披露的 Audio 一条说咖啡厅服务时听到的部分短促顾客语音（简短反应与感叹）由 AI 语音生成工具制作；同一句紧接着说游戏里所有对白台词均由真人声优录制，本站把这两句一并登记为语音领域已使用。
voice.quote: Some short customer vocal sounds heard during café service (brief reactions and exclamations) were created using AI voice generation tools.

writing.note: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。披露只说文本被 AI 翻译，没有说文本本身由 AI 撰写。

translation.note: 披露的 Translation 一条说除韩语以外的游戏内文本与商店页文本用 AI 工具翻译，并承认部分译文读起来不自然或有误，同时在 Discord 上做社群校对项目、承诺在后续更新里采纳玩家建议。
translation.quote: The in-game text and store page text in languages other than Korean were translated using AI tools, so some translations may read unnaturally or contain inaccuracies.

marketing.note: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。翻译一条虽提到商店页文本，但那属于翻译领域；披露没有点名商店图或宣传素材由 AI 生成。

summary: 第一人称女仆咖啡厅经营，2026 年 10 月 7 日上架，Accelix 与 SCON 开发、Accelix 发行，分类为模拟。商店 AI 披露分三条列出：除韩语以外的游戏内文本与商店页文本由 AI 工具翻译（开发者承认部分译文不自然或有误，并在 Discord 做社群校对）；部分食物与烹饪道具先由 AI 辅助生成、再由自家美术手工精修；服务时一些短促的顾客语音由 AI 语音生成工具制作，而所有台词由真人声优录制。本站据此把翻译、美术与语音登记为已使用，游戏内实时生成、代码、音乐、文本创作与宣传素材登记为未说明。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。
reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（三条项目符号原文）、身份（开发商 Accelix 与 SCON，发行商 Accelix，正式版）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题、总数 137，仅覆盖首页），首页没有命中关键词的 AI 主题帖；语音支持语言只有韩语，其余语言仅有文本，这与披露里对翻译的说明一致。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，6 条结果），登记并读取 2 条来源：gamedb.ai 的本作条目页与 pcgame.com 的本作页面，两者都转录了披露内容，其中 pcgame.com 逐字转录三条原文，用于核对商店披露未被截断；gamedb.ai 的转述把原文的 initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by our artists 压缩成 initially AI-generated, then manually refined by the artists，措辞比商店原文更绝对，本站结论只绑定商店原文。该站另给出 Translation Core、Art Partial 之类的领域等级，属其自身判定，未采纳。其余 4 条为试玩版页面、同名不同作品与 DLC 页面，按规则试玩版不充新增。未检索到独立媒体报道本作的 AI 争议。
description: 你继承的是一间濒临关店的老咖啡厅，直到一场面试里走进一位兽耳女孩：带着五位各有秘密的女仆重新开业，调饮、上座、扫码、找零，忙不过来时把单子分给她们，一路冲着三星女仆店的名头去，也有空摸摸头、给她们换装。

english.summary: A first-person maid cafe management game released on Oct 7, 2026, developed by Accelix and SCON, published by Accelix and filed under Simulation. Its Steam AI disclosure has three bullets: text in every language other than Korean, in game and on the store page, was translated with AI tools and the developer admits some translations may read unnaturally while a community proofreading project runs on Discord; some food and cooking props were initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by their artists; and some short customer vocal sounds during service were created with AI voice tools while all spoken dialogue was recorded by real voice performers. This site records translation, art and voice as used, and live in-game generation, code, music, writing and marketing as not addressed. Every finding rests on the developer own statement and none of it has been independently audited.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block with all three bullets, the identity (developers Accelix and SCON, publisher Accelix, a full release rather than a demo) and the English discussion homepage, which lists 15 visible topics out of 137 and covers only that first page, with no AI-related topic shown. The language support line on the store page lists Korean as the only language with full audio and text-only support for the others, which fits the translation bullet. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, all 6 results dispositioned and two sources registered and read in full: the gamedb.ai entry page and the pcgame.com page for this game. The pcgame.com page transcribes the three bullets verbatim and is used to confirm the store text was not truncated, while the gamedb.ai wording compresses initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by our artists into initially AI-generated, then manually refined by the artists, which is stronger than the store text, so every finding stays bound to the store wording. That aggregator also assigns its own Translation Core and Art Partial grades, which are its labels and are not adopted. The other results were demo pages, a same-name different product and a DLC page, and demos never count as an addition. No independent press report about this game AI controversy was found.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
aiAreaNotes.code: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
aiAreaNotes.art: The Art bullet says some food and cooking related props were initially generated with AI assisted tools and then manually refined by the developers own artists, so art is recorded as used with that human finishing claim attached.
aiAreaNotes.music: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use. The Audio bullet is about customer vocal sounds rather than music, and this site does not map that word onto the music area.
aiAreaNotes.voice: The Audio bullet says some short customer vocal sounds during cafe service were created with AI voice generation tools, and the same bullet adds that all spoken dialogue was recorded by real voice performers, which is why voice is recorded as used rather than clean.
aiAreaNotes.writing: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use. The disclosure says text was translated by AI, not that it was written by AI, and this site keeps those separate.
aiAreaNotes.translation: The Translation bullet says in-game and store page text in languages other than Korean was translated using AI tools, that some translations may read unnaturally or contain inaccuracies, and that a community translation project on Discord is meant to fix them in future updates.
aiAreaNotes.marketing: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use. The translation bullet mentions store page text, which belongs to the translation area; the disclosure never says store images or promotional material were AI generated.

disclosureQuote: • Translation: The in-game text and store page text in languages other than Korean were translated using AI tools, so some translations may read unnaturally or contain inaccuracies. We are running a community translation project on our Discord server and do our best to reflect players' suggestions in future updates. If you'd like to help, we'd truly appreciate it! • Art: Some food and cooking-related props were initially generated with AI-assisted tools and then manually refined by our artists to match the game's visual style and quality standards. • Audio: Some short customer vocal sounds heard during café service (brief reactions and exclamations) were created using AI voice generation tools. All spoken dialogue in the game was recorded by real voice performers.
